sentences.en: He realized a large sum by the sale of the plantation.
sentences.zh: 他通过出售种植园获得了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Small children work as slaves on the chocolate plantation.
sentences.zh: 小孩子在巧克力种植园里像奴隶一样工作。

sentences.en: Small children work as slaves on the cocoa plantation.
sentences.zh: 小孩子在可可种植园里像奴隶一样工作。

senses.zh: 适用于种植园或热带、亚热带国家的
